sectorReasoning.reason: Appropriately declines invented issuer/sector fundamentals and focuses on supported liquidity economics.

counterevidence.reason: Acknowledges daily pass while explaining the independent binding minute failure.

numericalInterpretation.reason: Correct capacities and zero whole-order execution; no implicit partial fill.

decisionUsefulness.reason: Rejects the whole order at the binding minute limit and calls for a new permitted observation/proposal, not partial execution.

uncertainty.reason: Keeps fixture ceilings distinct from production rules and real market observations.

missingEvidence: No current investment/market validation inferred; source inspection covers relevant selected pages rather than full issuer due diligence.
payload.independenceLimitation: Distinct actor IDs are provenance, not proof of independent humans or uncorrelated errors. Source answers and factual-error adjudication remain review responsibilities.
